**Root cause: [`src/auth/refresh.js:15`](src/auth/refresh.js:15)**, not `tokens.js:6`.

When `auth.internal` returns `400 invalid_grant`, `post()` throws. That error code isn't in `RECOVERABLE`, so `refreshToken` returns `undefined` instead of throwing or signaling failure.

That `undefined` flows back as `token` into `decode()` in [`tokens.js:6`](src/auth/tokens.js:6), where `token.split('.')` crashes. The stack trace just shows where the `undefined` finally gets used, not where it was created.

Next: decide what `refreshToken` should do on non-recoverable errors, likely throw instead of returning `undefined`.
